scope: Additional risk-focused framework-wide performance/security review after C05; not a line-by-line or exhaustive security proof

findings.status: fixed; original behavior reproduced where applicable; regressions/races and final gate passed
findings.trigger: Exists/Expire captures time before waiting on the driver lock or database transaction. Existing entry expires during the wait. Inspect still considers the entry live; Expire can revive it.
findings.fix: Evaluate live state and relative TTL using the authoritative clock under the driver atomic boundary; retain one shared expiry policy.
findings.proof: Real file/PostgreSQL contention regressions, original-source overlays and 20 race-enabled repetitions.

findings.status: fixed; original behavior reproduced where applicable; regressions/races and final gate passed
findings.trigger: Each new insertion into a full cache scans all entries in purgeExpired even when all are persistent or none is due. Work under one mutex scales with capacity.
findings.fix: Track a conservative earliest expiry boundary and skip the scan when no expiry is due, preserving expiry-before-LRU semantics and in-place TTL updates.
findings.proof: Existing cache/tag/counter tests plus expiry-boundary regressions and same-host before/after capacity scaling benchmarks.

findings.status: fixed; original behavior reproduced where applicable; regressions/races and final gate passed
findings.trigger: A custom request/response reader repeatedly returning (0,nil) can busy-loop under io.ReadAll until the operation timeout.
findings.fix: Reuse workscope.Reader for the existing 100-empty-read progress bound, preserving actual read/close ownership and sticky errors.
findings.proof: Sticky failure and recovery after intermittent progress regressions; stream lifecycle races; before/after body read benchmark.

benchmark_conditions: Native Apple M4 Max, Go 1.27.1, ordinary compiler defaults; sequential before/after and runtime benchmarks with no concurrent assistant verification workload. OS cache, thermal state and other desktop workloads were not controlled. Full gate and fuzzing overlapped; their durations are acceptance timings, not benchmark comparisons.

original_source_reproductions.disposition: Expected assertion failures against saved original runtime source using overlays; fixed source was never replaced.

prior_measurement_cache_reclamation.reason: Space for fresh native measurements after broad race compilation; removed only recomputable caches of the completed C05 measurement run. Logs, reports, artifacts, copied/generated source, executables, module licenses and editor caches retained.

changes.source_review: All six runtime diffs and seven new regression/benchmark sources reviewed after targeted races. Original overlays reproduce R01/R03; R02 retains all cache operation paths under the mutex. No dependency, global state, background task or public consumer service API added.

limits: Known database entries and native configuration only; retained module-only tool/runtime advisories are documented.
Fuzzing uses a three-second search per target plus seed coverage; it is a smoke campaign.
Memory-cache sweep remains linear when an expiry may be due; benchmarks isolate no-due-entry churn.
File/PostgreSQL cache quota enforcement retains coarse locking and entry/file scans; persistent adapter correctness is covered, not production throughput at capacity.
Stream protection targets custom readers and adds one allocation; it does not preempt a callback that never returns.
Cloud account delivery, production load and other operating systems were not re-certified.
Whole-framework original C05 limitations, including broad consumer compiler cost and external mail smoke gaps, remain documented.

completion_audit.documentation: Final links, numbering, fixture versions and factual report checks passed.
